Maya K: Quick follow-up on the loader-abstraction RFC — I prototyped a small shim to separate shard resolution from I/O. Posting notes.

Cheng Li: nice, high level?

Maya K: Idea: introduce a WeightResolver trait that's responsible for: 1) mapping model manifest entries -> shard URIs (local/multi-URI), 2) returning read capabilities (supports_mmap / supports_stream / checksum), 3) producing a ShardHandle with read_range and mmap_hint.

Samir R: so the resolver handles both safetensors manifests and older single-file checkpoints?

Maya K: Exactly. Resolver plugins: safetensor-manifest, legacy-ckpt-finder. Each plugin can annotate shards with preferred warmup strategy: FULL_MMAP, STREAM_CHUNKS, KV_WARMUP.

Alex P: How do we handle remote objects on S3 that support ranged GETs vs those behind proxies without range? We can't require mmap.

Maya K: ShardHandle will expose read_range(offset, len) and optionally mmap_map() that may raise NotSupported. Warmup runner will ask for preferred strategy but fall back: try mmap -> if NotSupported then stream with parallel ranges -> if fails, throttle to sequential.

Cheng Li: we need a deterministic byte layout for safetensors to precompute kv-cache offsets for warmup. Are we standardizing an index in the manifest?

Maya K: Proposal: manifest entries include an "kv_index" field per tensor: {name, offset, byte_length, dtype, sha256}. This lets warmup only fetch relevant slices. Also helps cross-shard alignment when sharding changes but layout is stable.

Samir R: for backward compat, loader should accept manifests without kv_index and fall back to full-tensor fetch + in-memory scan. Add a build-time tool to generate kv_index from model artifacts.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: test/shard-resolver-v1 on staging at 2026-06-15T04:00Z :robot_face:

Alex P: Perf question: parallel ranged GETs are great but S3 costs spike. Could we batch ranges into fewer requests? e.g. coalesce adjacent ranges per shard.

Maya K: yep, warmup runner will coalesce ranges heuristically and cap concurrent requests per host. Also metric: bytes_requested vs bytes_used to tune default thresholds.

Cheng Li: Security: verify sha256 from manifest on each mapped region. If mismatch, fetch full shard and mark for reupload or fail safe.

Samir R: devex ask: what's the public API for ops teams? Something like load_model(manifest_uri, opts) that returns a ModelInstance with pinned shards + a warmup status stream?

Maya K: That's the plan. load_model returns a descriptor and a WarmupFuture that emits progress events. Ops can block until warmup.complete or use minimal-serving mode.

Alex P: Sounds good. I can prototype resolver plugin scaffolding this week, and Samir can own the warmup runner. Cheng can spec the manifest kv_index format.

Maya K: SGTM. I'll push the prototype branch and a short README. If no objections, we'll fold into the RFC as an "implementation notes" section.

Cheng Li: :thumbsup:

Samir R: :+1:
